parts.text:
Study Fig. 6.2, which shows information about a farm in the Netherlands.
The farm is fairly small, only 90 hectares in size, and is situated on fertile land which was
reclaimed from the sea about 80 years ago. The land is flat, below sea level in places, and
has to be constantly drained by ditches which surround the fields. The farmer specialises
in growing flowers in greenhouses using large amounts of fertilisers and pesticides.
Large amounts of wheat, potatoes and sugar beet are also grown in the fields. Using
greenhouses helps the farmer to harvest flowers out of season, when prices are high in
the shops, and grow unusual expensive varieties. Although the farm is highly mechanised
there are two full-time workers and part-time workers are employed during planting and
harvesting times.
